bibman_core_library_notes: v18: papers are looked up on ADS only by a DOI, arXiv number (old forms such as astro-ph/0701517 too) or bibcode, and ADS's answer is used only if it carries that identifier. In each web app: Libraries → BibManCore → select version 18, then Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version (the web apps' own numbers stay the same)
